fees.notes: Public girls' high school with a hostel. 2026 school fees R57,156 a year, or R5,196 a month for 11 months (January to November, debit order). Pay the year before 28 February 2026 and the fee is R51,440. New learners pay a R50 application administration fee and a R5,000 admission orientation registration fee. Hostel is extra: R87,000 a year for Grades 8-11 (R78,300 if paid before 28 February 2026) or R21,750 a term; Grade 12 R87,000 (R78,300) or R29,000 before each of the first 3 terms. Hostel leavers in Grades 8-11 who don't give the required notice pay a penalty equal to three months' fees (no rand amount printed). Music (instrument hire or practical music) is R480 a month for 10 months, R1,200 a term or R4,800 a year. Hospitality/Consumer Studies (Food) R550 a year.

fees.notes: Fee-paying public girls' primary school in Queenstown (Komani). 2026 fee structure: R33,561 a year; R8,390.25 a term (first week of each term); R3,051 a month (by the last school day of each month). New pupils pay a R5,000 deposit, which is part of the R33,561, and then R7,140.25 a term or R2,596.50 a month (R2,596 in November) as printed. A R1,000 settlement discount is allowed if fees are settled in full by 31 January 2026, bringing the year to R32,561. This is the 2026 schedule; no 2027 schedule was found. The school's boarding page gives no amounts and describes boarding at Queenstown Girls' High School.

fees.notes: Fee-paying public girls' primary school. Compulsory school fees for 2026: R25,652 a year per child for Grade 00 to 7, due on the first day of the school year. Options: pay in full by 31 December 2025 and get 10% off (R23,087), pay in full by 31 January 2026 (R23,857), or 11 monthly payments on the last day of the month; ask the school for the monthly amount. Optional extras: aftercare (12:30 to 17:15) R700 a month for 10 months, casual day R50; music tuition R320, instrument hire R270 and percussion R60 a month for 10 months; remedial lessons R480 a term.

fees.notes: Christian school, Pre Gr R to Gr 12. 2026 fees, entry grade Pre Gr R and Reception shown: R15,400 a year, paid as 11 monthly payments of R1,400 (January to November). Other grades: Gr 1-3 R1,750, Gr 4-6 R1,800, Gr 7-9 R1,900, Gr 10-12 R2,100 a month. No discount for paying the full year in advance. Registration R1,200 (it was R1,100 if paid by 5 December 2025), only if space is available; it covers textbooks, photocopies and stationery. Paying cash into the school account adds 1% bank charge; lost or damaged books are charged to the parent (no amounts printed, not in hidden costs). The school is cashless. The sheet has no 2027 fees yet.

State school (Quintile 5, fee-charging). 2027 school fee resolution accepted by parents at the AGM on 17 November 2026: one annual fee for all grades, R30 360.00, payable on the first day of Term 1 2027, or R2 760 a month, paid before the 7th of each month, 11 payments from January to November 2027. Full-payment discounts, only if paid in full by the date: 10% by 31 December 2026, 7% by 31 January 2027, 5% by 28 February 2027. Aftercare R1 000 a month (14:00 to 17:30). Music fees are extra: individual lesson R180 a month, brass and wind instrument hire R180 a month, reeds R65 a month (each over 11 months), remedial lesson R200 a term. Bus fares may be charged if used. A stationery fee is charged but no amount is given. Fee exemption can be applied for. The letter is a scanned PDF read by OCR only; the school's pin from the DBE list is rounded, check on the map.
